title: a 50 m/s drift below maxSpeed brakes by raw thrust 32 per second
derivation: Inputs: the player Cobra Mk III, initial drift (30, 0, 40) (float magnitude 50 m/s), thrust 32, dt = 1/120 s, 190 ticks. flightSpeed 100 <= maxFlightSpeed 350, so thrust_factor = 1.0 (PlayerEntity.m:3378-3385). Every tick applyVelocity runs first, position += (double)velocity x dt (3376, Entity.m:878-881); then velmag = f(sqrt(magnitude2(velocity))) and velmag2 = f(velmag - f(f(f(dt) x 32) x thrust_factor)) = velmag - 0.2666666805744171 (3387-3388). velmag2 < 0 zeroes the drift, else velocity x f(velmag2 / velmag) (3401-3404). Tick 1 removes 0.2666664123535156 m/s. The drift reaches zero on tick 188. Position change over the 190 ticks: (23.562687950332965, 0, 31.416917255272466) m.
